hypotheses.reasoning: The postgres data volume filled up on its own. Disk usage was 95% at 20:15:26 and 99% at 20:18:59, with WAL growing at about 700MB/h. From 20:22:06 postgres logged 'could not extend file: No space left on device'. In the same window order-service inserts into orders failed with DiskFullError, SQLSTATE 53100 and 'could not extend file'. The gateway's POST /checkout 500s all come from order-service. Reads stay healthy because only writes need new disk space, which matches the alert. Other errors are unrelated: account-svc's status_v2 column errors only hit /login through edge-proxy, flag-sync's unknown-flag errors keep the cached value, and billing-reconciler's checksum errors are on old archive rows. No deploy shows up in the logs.
A missing accounts.status_v2 column (an incomplete migration) breaks account-svc. However, it only affects /login, not /checkout.

verdict.recommendedAction: Free up space on the postgres data volume now: grow the volume, find out why WAL is piling up (a stuck replication slot or failing archiving) and clear the old WAL. Then add disk-usage alerts at 85% and 95%. Separately, finish the accounts.status_v2 migration (or roll back account-svc) to fix the /login 500s.
